contracts: (A successful replay exposes a passing non-authority-binding verification outcome, while a missing or altered binding makes the replay verification fail.) AND (All six case records show Stable-subject execution and equality of pre-execution and post-execution Stable identity/content.) AND (No exhausted time or output budget can produce success, pending status, or an ambiguous terminal classification.) AND (Replay succeeds only when post-sequence route identity, verdict, and diagnostic outputs exactly match the captured baseline; any mismatch is a failed result.) AND (Replay validation passes only when the successful Replay Result contains a distinct passing command-verification record with the declared native command identity; missing, aggregate-only, or mismatched command verification fails validation.) AND (Support is accepted only when Windows is explicitly identified, handled by the declared branch, and not rejected solely due to platform identity.) AND (The aggregate is successful only when evidence contains both subject executions for each of six matrix cases; any missing pair is terminally failed.) AND (The evaluator emits an explicit failed terminal classification for the infrastructure-failure false-negative case.) AND (The existing replay selector observes a detached-negative receipt entry with a nonzero exit result and process identity distinct from the replay runner; an in-process, simulated, or zero-exit negative Probe fails the selector.) AND (The replay command reports an invalid aggregate when the Matrix Case evidence target differs from the declared target, without a valid aggregate status.) AND (The replay command returns an unsuccessful aggregate for the adversarial dependency selector, and neither the case nor aggregate reports success.) AND (The replay command returns an unsuccessful aggregate for the stale-input selector, and no case or aggregate field reports success.) AND (成功结果包含独立 dependency verification outcome、每项依赖证据且验证器通过。)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
selector_intents: Run the matrix evaluator with one case missing one required subject execution; the matrix aggregate must fail.
